entries.title: A crewmate's reminder no longer stops an approved merge
entries.body: A timed reminder to check a merge again no longer stops a merge the app approved. Real waits still stop it. If the last check refuses a merge, the task records the reason, tells the first mate once and waits longer before trying again.
entries.noPicture: The change is in when an approved merge runs and how a refusal is recorded, not a screen layout.
